usageNote: 鼓励人跳出舒适区的万能句！语气积极正能量，朋友聊天、演讲都能用，超有感染力✨

examples.en: This weekend, why not try something you've never tried before, like rock climbing?
examples.zh: 这个周末，何不尝试一件从没做过的事，比如攀岩？

examples.en: Life gets exciting when you try something you've never tried before.
examples.zh: 当你尝试从未做过的事，生活就变得刺激起来了。
